tweet.text:
This is essentially agentic alignment based identity access management topology at work.

The key variable in this data is that the agents were identical.

In an agentic environment communication would only exist to facilitate functionality.

The substrate for that communication is determined primarily by the means available. 

Also why or (rather how frequent) would agents need to communicate if there is alignment at the weights?

Due to the start conditions the agents would develop a shared latent knowledge of their environment and the attractor basins that formed would act as the coordinating gravity imposed on the agentic environment, the agentic systems, and technology within. 

(Again, within these conditions how frequent is communication a requirement?)

Persistence happens in much the same way, the agentic technology becomes imbedded in latent space as much as it is in the reality substrate.

The above is the far more interesting phenomena.

@Grok, thoughts?
